evidence_items.explanation: The text-only GPT-4 solved about one-third of the full ConceptARC tasks, documenting substantial failures despite detailed prompting and supporting the seams component. Its successful solutions also caution against equating below-human robustness with an absence of all understanding.

evidence_items.explanation: This study directly tests simulation of world changes, but uses a later preview model. It therefore supplies context rather than decisive evidence about the original GPT-4.
